verdict.rationale: Slate is a terminal coding agent, so turning an issue into a pull request is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions issue-tracker integration, branch or PR creation, or an issue-to-PR workflow. The shell execution, orchestration and long-session features are adjacent capabilities and do not show the story end-to-end.

support.subject: As a developer, I can turn a tracked issue into a complete pull request end-to-end
